proposals.evidence: The older-sister expression has big/elder + sister. CDIAL 11225 supplies baṛā/baḍā/vaḍḍā with elder usage and feminine agreement; CDIAL 9349 gives bhēṇ/bhaiṇ, bahin/bahan and related regional sister forms. Ordered component-family edges preserve the complete phrase and source p/bh, nasal, breathy and vowel notation. The debated deeper origin of vaḍra and local Indo-Aryan transmission remain open; no single ancient compound is asserted. Exact response: baḍī bahin.
